## goal

why this change exists in one or two sentences.

## summary

- bullet points of what changed

## design decisions

non-obvious choices and the reasoning behind them.

## edge cases

what could break, and how this change handles it.

## test plan

- [ ] `go test -race -cover ./...`
- [ ] `go vet ./...`, `staticcheck ./...`, `gosec ./...`, `govulncheck ./...`
- [ ] manual verification (describe)
